name: ai-diagram-maker-mcp

tools.name: generate_diagram_from_text
tools.description: Generate a software engineering diagram from a natural language description. Use this tool when: the user asks to 'create a diagram', 'show me a flowchart', 'visualise the architecture', uses the keyword 'adm' or 'ai diagram maker', or asks for any visual representation of code, systems, processes or data flows. Supported diagram types: flowchart, sequence, ERD, system architecture, network architecture, UML, mindmap, workflow. Returns a link to view and edit the generated diagram in the browser.

content.description: Natural language description of the diagram to generate. Be descriptive — include components, relationships, data flows, etc. Example: "Create a microservices architecture with API gateway, auth service, user service, and PostgreSQL database"

diagramType.description: Preferred diagram type. Leave blank to let the AI infer the best type from your description.

prompt.description: Additional styling or layout instruction. Example: "Use left-to-right layout with pastel colors"

isIconEnabled.description: Set to true when the user asks to include icons in the diagram.

tools.name: generate_diagram_from_json
tools.description: Generate a diagram from a JSON structure. Use this tool when the user wants to visualise JSON data such as API responses, database schemas, dependency trees, configuration files, or any structured data. Pass the raw JSON string as `content`. Returns a link to view and edit the generated diagram in the browser.

content.description: A JSON string representing the structure to visualise. This can be API response data, a database schema, a config file, dependency tree, or any other structured JSON. Example: '{"users": [{"id": 1, "orders": [{"id": 101}]}]}'

prompt.description: Instruction for how to interpret or render the JSON. Example: "Show as an entity relationship diagram with cardinality labels"

diagramType.description: Preferred diagram type. Defaults to 'erd' for schemas and 'flowchart' for other JSON.

isIconEnabled.description: Set to true when the user asks to include icons in the diagram.

tools.name: generate_diagram_from_ascii
tools.description: Convert an ASCII art diagram into a polished visual diagram. Use this tool when the user has an existing ASCII art representation of a system, flow, or architecture and wants it rendered as a proper diagram. Accepts box-drawing characters, arrow representations (-->, ==>), and plain text layouts. Returns a link to view and edit the generated diagram in the browser.

content.description:
Raw ASCII art diagram to convert into a polished visual diagram. Include the full ASCII art as-is, with box-drawing characters, arrows, or plain text layout. Example:
  +--------+     +--------+
  | Client | --> | Server |
  +--------+     +--------+

prompt.description: Additional instruction for rendering. Example: "Use a dark theme and add icons"

diagramType.description: Preferred diagram type. Leave blank to let the AI infer from the ASCII layout.

isIconEnabled.description: Set to true when the user asks to include icons in the diagram.

tools.name: generate_diagram_from_image
tools.description: Convert an image (whiteboard photo, screenshot, hand-drawn sketch) into a clean diagram. Use this tool when the user provides an image URL or base64-encoded image and wants it converted to a proper software engineering diagram. Accepts public image URLs or base64 data URIs (data:image/...;base64,...). Returns a link to view and edit the generated diagram in the browser.

content.description: Either a public image URL or a base64 data URI of the image to convert. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP. For a URL: 'https://example.com/whiteboard.png'. For a data URI: 'data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo...'

prompt.description: Instruction describing what to extract or how to render the diagram. Example: "Convert this whiteboard photo into a clean sequence diagram"

diagramType.description: Preferred output diagram type. Leave blank to let the AI decide based on the image content.

isIconEnabled.description: Set to true when the user asks to include icons in the diagram.

tools.name: generate_diagram_from_mermaid
tools.description: Convert a Mermaid diagram definition into a D2 diagram and return a PNG image. Use this tool when the user has existing Mermaid code (flowchart, sequenceDiagram, erDiagram, etc.) and wants it converted to D2 or rendered as an image. Pass the Mermaid source as content. Returns a link to view and edit the generated diagram in the browser.

content.description:
A Mermaid diagram definition to convert to D2. Pass the raw Mermaid source (e.g. flowchart, sequenceDiagram, erDiagram). Example: "flowchart LR
  A --> B --> C"

prompt.description: Optional instruction for layout or styling of the converted diagram.

diagramType.description: Preferred diagram type for the converted D2 output.

isIconEnabled.description: Set to true when the user asks to include icons in the diagram.

instructions: This server generates software engineering diagrams using AI Diagram Maker (ADM). Use the available tools to create diagrams from natural language descriptions, JSON data, ASCII art, images, or Mermaid diagram definitions. Trigger keywords: 'adm', 'ai diagram maker', 'create diagram', 'show diagram', 'visualise', 'draw a flowchart', 'sequence diagram', 'architecture diagram'. When the user requests icons or mentions 'with icons', 'include icons', or 'add icons', pass isIconEnabled: true to the tool — icon support is controlled by this parameter.
